page.overview:
Who is Dr. Renault?

Dr. Renault was an alias used by the Baroness. It is unknown if a real Dr. Renault exists.

Dr. Renault was the leader of a research team specializing in the development of a transmuter. She was provided safe escort by Joe members Flint and Lady Jaye. Renault and her staff were being transported on a train reinforced with interior titanium steel walls. She introduced U.S. Army General Wagstaff as the military liaison assigned to the security of her transmuter research project. The purpose of this disguise was to retrieve the blueprints to the transmuter believed to be in the Joe's possession. Joe members Flint and Lady Jaye quickly realized both the doctor and general were imposters, forcing the pair to reveal themselves as Zartan and Baroness.

Category:Sunbow only characters Category:Civilian characters Category:Female Characters
